# Sosialisasi & Edukasi



## Row {height="25%}

```{r}
#| title: "Nama Pemateri Sosialisasi"
clean_sosialisasi %>%
  group_by(`Nama Pemateri Sosialisasi`, Dusun) %>%
  summarise(`Jumlah Peserta` = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(`Jumlah Peserta`)) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 5,
      dom = "t",
      scrollY = "120px"
    ),
    rownames = FALSE,
    style = "bootstrap4"
  )
```


## Row {height="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Kategori Umur Peserta"

df_umur <- clean_sosialisasi %>%
  count(`Kategori Umur`) %>%
  mutate(
    `Kategori Umur` = factor(
      `Kategori Umur`,
      levels = c("18-25", "26-35", "36-45", "46-55", "55+")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Kategori Umur`)

warna_umur <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "D", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_umur))

df_umur %>%
  plot_ly(
    x      = ~`Kategori Umur`,
    y      = ~n,
    type   = "bar",
    marker = list(color = warna_umur)
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis         = list(title = "Kategori Umur", color = "white"),
    yaxis         = list(title = "Jumlah Peserta", color = "white"),
    paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
    plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
    font          = list(color = "white")
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Distribusi Jenis Kelamin"

clean_sosialisasi %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Jenis Kelamin`)) %>%
  count(`Jenis Kelamin`) %>%
  plot_ly(
    labels  = ~`Jenis Kelamin`,
    values  = ~n,
    type    = "pie",
    hole    = 0.4,
    marker  = list(
      colors = c("#00b894", "#fdcb6e"),
      line   = list(color = "#222222", width = 2)
    ),
    domain  = list(y = c(0.15, 1))
  ) %>%
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
    plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
    font          = list(color = "white"),
    legend        = list(
      orientation = "h",
      xanchor     = "center",
      yanchor     = "top",
      x           = 0.5,
      y           = 0.05,
      font        = list(color = "white")
    )
  )
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Jenis Insentif Diusulkan"

df_insentif <- clean_aspirasi %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`)) %>%
  count(`Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan` = factor(
      `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`, 
      levels = `Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`
    )
  )

warna_insentif <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "G", begin = 0.3, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_insentif))

df_insentif %>%
  plot_ly(
    x      = ~`Jenis Insentif Diusulkan`,
    y      = ~n,
    type   = "bar",
    marker = list(color = warna_insentif)
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis         = list(
      title     = "", 
      color     = "white",
      tickangle = 0
    ),
    yaxis         = list(title = "Jumlah", color = "white"),
    paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
    plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
    font          = list(color = "white"),
    margin        = list(b = 140)
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Intensitas Rencana Pembakaran per Desa"

  filter(!is.na(Desa)) %>%

  arrange(desc(n))

df_jadwal_desa %>%
  plot_ly(
    x      = ~factor(Desa, levels = Desa),
    y      = ~n,
    type   = "bar",

  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis         = list(title = "", color = "white", tickangle = 0),
    yaxis         = list(title = "Jumlah Jadwal", color = "white"),
    paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
    plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
    font          = list(color = "white"),
    margin        = list(b = 60)
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Intensitas Rencana Pembakaran per Bulan"
df_bulan_bakar <- clean_jadwalmembakar %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Tanggal Pembakaran Lahan`)) %>%
  mutate(Bulan = format(`Tanggal Pembakaran Lahan`, "%b %Y")) %>%
  count(Bulan) %>%
  arrange(ymd(paste0("01 ", Bulan)))

warna_bulan_bakar <- scales::viridis_pal(option = "E", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9)(nrow(df_bulan_bakar))

df_bulan_bakar %>%
  plot_ly(
    x      = ~factor(Bulan, levels = Bulan),
    y      = ~n,
    type   = "bar",
    marker = list(color = warna_bulan_bakar)
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis         = list(title = "", color = "white", tickangle = 0),
    yaxis         = list(title = "Jumlah Jadwal", color = "white"),
    paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
    plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
    font          = list(color = "white"),
    margin        = list(b = 60)
  )
```

## Row {height="85%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Peta Sebaran Titik Insiden & Aktivitas Pembakaran"

library(leaflet)

pal_peta <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#ff7675", "#00b894"),
  domain  = clean_hotspot$`Tipe Insiden`
)

clean_hotspot %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude)) %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Longitude,
    lat = ~Latitude,
    radius = 7,
    color = ~pal_peta(`Tipe Insiden`),
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1.5,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
   popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='color: #222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4;'>",
      "<b>Desa:</b> ", Desa, "<br>",
      "<b>Dusun:</b> ", Dusun, "<br>",
      "<b>Tipe Insiden:</b> ", `Tipe Insiden`, "<br>",
      "<b>Nama Pemilik Lahan:</b> ", `Nama Pemilik Lahan`, "<br>",
      "<b>Tanggal:</b> ", Tanggal, "<br>",
      "<b>Luas Terbakar (Ha):</b> ", `Luas Terbakar (Ha)`, " Ha<br>",
      "<b>Keterangan:</b> ", Keterangan,
      "</div>"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal_peta,
    values = ~`Tipe Insiden`,
    title = "Kategori Insiden",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```
